leadIn: By the end of this lesson, learners will be able to:
objectives: Construct a custom React hook function to encapsulate feature flag logic.
Define TypeScript interfaces to type the feature flag configuration object.
Utilize the useState hook to store and update the active state of a feature flag.
Apply conditional logic to control the rendering of UI components based on flag state.
Implement a toggle handler function to switch the feature flag on and off.
Use the useEffect hook to persist the flag state to localStorage.
Retrieve the initial flag state from localStorage on component mount.
Return the flag state and toggle function from the custom hook for component consumption.
Invoke the custom hook within a functional component to access its returned values.
Assign the returned flag state to conditionally render JSX elements.
Modify the flag configuration to add new feature flags with default states.
Control component behavior by wiring the toggle handler to a UI event like a button click.
